matching: Expected objects match when every listed key is present with an equal value; unlisted keys are not checked. "$num", "$str", "$bool" match any value of that type, "$any" matches anything including null. Arrays must have the same length and match element by element. expect [] = the Due sends nothing. line_gen: prefix + fill repeated up to length bytes (+ suffix, counted in length), no newline.

state.geometry: the firmware's Settings.h / Manifold.h (15 slots, purge 0, FILL_ORDER as in GET_INFO)
